701-2390-3966.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
701-2390-3966.description:
Gain life.
Ajani's Pridemate triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it
All Will Be One triggers, dealing 1 damage to an opponent.
Exquisite Blood triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

2734-3469-5261.easyPrerequisites:
Energy Arc is exiled by Isochron Scepter.
Isochron Scepter doesn't have summoning sickness.
2734-3469-5261.notablePrerequisites: Creatures you control can tap to produce at least {2}.
2734-3469-5261.description:
Animate Isochron Scepter using Cyberdrive Awakener.
Activate any number of creatures by tapping them, adding at least {2}.
Activate Isochron Scepter by paying {2} and tapping it, casting a copy of Energy Arc without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Energy Arc, untapping all creatures you control
Repeat from step 2.

2586-2921-7690--165.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Odric's Outrider triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the other Hero
Invisible Woman triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability
Repeat

132-549-1283-4687.easyPrerequisites: Myr Welder does not have summoning sickness.
132-549-1283-4687.description:
Activate Myr Welder using Chromatic Orrery's ability by tapping it, adding at least {2}{G/U}.
Activate Myr Welder using Gilder Bairn's ability by paying {2}{G/U} and untapping it, targeting any permanent.
Repeat.
132-549-1283-4687.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you may instead use Chromatic Orrery's second ability to draw infinite cards.

222-527-1753-3899.easyPrerequisites:
You control a Saproling.
You control a creature with power 5 or greater.
222-527-1753-3899.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {1}{B}{R}{G}{G}.
Activate Spawning Pit twice by sacrificing Selvala and Slimefoot and Squee.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and Selvala from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.

2741-7690-7743--165.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
2741-7690-7743--165.description:
Gain life.
Heroic Feast triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the other Hero.
Invisible Woman triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Essence Warden triggers, causing you to gain life.
Repeat from step 2.

430-2743-4321-6222.easyPrerequisites: You haven't created any tokens this turn.
430-2743-4321-6222.description:
Declare Emissary Green as an attacker, triggering its ability. Choose to vote for "Profit", creating at least three token copies of Biovisionary due to Esix and Peregrin Took.
At the beginning of your end step, each Biovisionary triggers.
Resolve the first Biovisionary trigger, causing you to win the game.

4419-5686--5.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to Renata
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Repeat

5086-5256-6972.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Triskelavus.
When Triskelavus dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Repeat.

1563-3899-4365-4742.description:
Activate Spawning Pit's second ability by paying {1} and removing two charge counters from it, creating two creature tokens
Activate the tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Activate Spawning Pit's first ability twice by sacrificing the tokens, putting two charge counters on Spawning Pit.
Repeat.

2921-3678-6879.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
2921-3678-6879.description:
Play a land.
When the land enters, Retreat to Emeria triggers, creating a 1/1 Kor Ally creature token.
When the Kor Ally enters, Haru triggers, earthbending the land that entered.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing the earthbended land.
Haru triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Retreat to Emeria triggers, creating a 1/1 Kor Ally creature token.
When the Kor Ally enters, Haru triggers, earthbending the land that entered.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability from step 4.
Repeat from step 4.

539-2244-4803-6965.notablePrerequisites: You control a permanent that can tap to produce at least {W}.
539-2244-4803-6965.description:
Activate a permanent by tapping it, adding at least {W}.
Activate Nimbleclaw Adept by tapping it, untapping Ruin Ghost and the permanent.
Activate Ruin Ghost by paying {W} and tapping it, blinking Nimbleclaw Adept.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Grim Poppet and with toughness 2 or greater

2760-3108-3455.description:
Activate Grim Poppet by removing a -1/-1 counter from it, putting a -1/-1 counter on Vizier of Many Faces.
Nest of Scarabs triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Vizier of Many Faces by removing a -1/-1 counter from it, putting a -1/-1 counter on Grim Poppet.
Nest of Scarabs triggers, creating a creature token.
Repeat.

339-677-1849-6797.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Jegantha.
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

1491-2313-4474-6218.description:
Activate Pheres-Band Tromper by tapping it, adding {1}.
Activate Pheres-Band Tromper by paying {1} and putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping it.
Pheres-Band Tromper triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Repeat.

2043-2557-4050-6671.description:
Activate Urza by paying {6}, creating two token copies of Magic Pot that are 1/1 Soldiers.
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing the Magic Pot tokens, adding {2}.
When the Magic Pot tokens die, they trigger, creating four Treasure tokens.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {4}.
Repeat.

2743-6471-6570.description:
Cast Mnemonic Deluge by paying {6}{U}{U}{U}, exiling Will of the Temur and casting three copies of it without paying their mana costs.
Resolve the three Will of the Temur copies, creating three token copies of Biovisionary.
At the beginning of your end step, each Biovisionary you control triggers.
Resolve the first trigger, causing you to win the game.

813-4013-6103-6492.description:
Cast Illusion of Choice by paying {U}, allowing you to decide how each player votes this turn and causing you to draw a a card.
Cast Plea for Power by paying {3}{U}, choosing all votes to be for time, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Activate Eldrazi Displacer by paying {2}{C}, blinking Scholar of the Ages.
When Scholar of the Ages enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Illusion of Choice and Plea for Power from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat each turn.

2793-3743-5089-5435-6441.manaNeeded: {5} available, with an additional {5} every fourth turn
2793-3743-5089-5435-6441.description:
Activate Osgir by paying {5}, tapping it and exiling Ugin's Nexus from your graveyard, creating four token copies of Ugin's Nexus.
Put three of the Ugin's Nexus tokens into exile due to the legend rule and their replacement effects, causing you to take three extra turns after this one.
Activate Karn's first loyalty ability by putting a loyalty counter on it, choosing to do nothing.
Move to your next extra turn.
Repeat from step 3 one additional time.
Activate Karn's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, returning Ugin's Nexus from exile to your hand.
Activate Dream Trawler by discarding Ugin's Nexus.
Move to your last extra turn.
Repeat.

413-2590-5776.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature
413-2590-5776.description:
Activate Blasting Station by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies as a Food due to Ygra, Experimental Confectioner's second ability triggers, causing you to create a 1/1 Rat creature token.
When the Rat enters the battlefield, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 1, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat.

uses.n: Ojer Taq, Deepest Foundation // Temple of Civilization

1270-2034-4790.notablePrerequisites: You have at least one nonlegendary creature card exiled with Dino DNA.
1270-2034-4790.description:
Activate Dino DNA by paying {6}, creating three token copies of a nonlegendary creature exiled with it that are 6/6 Dinosaurs.
Activate Ashnod's Altar three times by sacrificing the creature tokens, adding six {C}.
Repeat.

345-1992-5256.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one additional creature that has a +1/+1 counter on it.
"Knight" chosen with Metallic Mimic.
345-1992-5256.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing another creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When the creature dies, Basri's Lieutenant's second ability triggers, creating a 2/2 Knight creature token that enters the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter due to Metallic Mimic.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability, causing target player to mill cards equal to the sacrificed creature's power.
Repeat.

2686-3263-4659.notablePrerequisites: You have no cards in hand.
2686-3263-4659.description:
On the end step prior to your turn, activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrifcing any permanent besides itself, Mycosynth Lattice, or Barren Glory, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat step 1 until you only have Krark-Clan Ironworks, Mycosynth Lattice, and Barren Glory on the battlefield.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Mycosynth Lattice, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing itself, adding {C}{C}.
At the beginning of your next upkeep, Barren Glory triggers, causing you to win the game.

3002-5065.description:
Activate Helm of Obedience by paying {1} and tapping it, causing target opponent to mill a card.
Due to Rest in Peace's replacement effect, the milled card is exiled instead of going to the graveyard, and that opponents repeats that process until their library is empty.
